thread:
sarah: quick handoff for tonight's overnight shift — i'm primary until 06:00 UTC, lee you're secondary. i'm heads-up'ing everyone in thread. :wave:

lee: got it. are we expecting any scheduled jobs or deploys that could impact latency?

sarah: there's a small rollout in us-west at 23:30 UTC but it's behind a canary. devops noted higher db replication lag window ~00:15-00:40 UTC. i left a note in the runbook.

alex: tagging runbook link here: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/oncall/night-shift-handoff (see section "DB replication spike"), devops checklist attached.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT-BOT: Active incident 2026-03-13T23:10Z — "Embed generation errors" — severity: P2 — page route: eng-oncall -> primary -> secondary after 5m. PagerDuty incident: PD12345.

sarah: thanks. alex can you paste the quick mitigation steps for embed errors? need something we can run if it fires while i'm on call.

alex: sure. quick mitigation (TL;DR):
```
1) confirm error rate via /alerts embed-errors (>5% threshold)
2) check model variant routing (console -> routes -> embeddings) and switch to fallback model (v1.3-quant) if latency spikes
3) throttle ingestion by 30% via feature-flag until traffic cools
4) notify customers via status page if >30m
```

lee: good checklist. what's our escalation rule for customer-impact incidents tonight? i remember we escalate to eng-leads at P1 and to oncall-rotations for sustained P2.

carla: here's the official escalation matrix copied from ops doc:
- P1 (site down / data loss): page primary + pager escalation within 2 mins -> if no ack in 5 mins escalate to eng-lead oncall and oncall-manager.
- P2 (partial outage / degraded customer experience): page primary -> if no progress within 10 mins escalate to secondary and on-duty engineering manager.
- P3 (minor issue): message channel and create ticket; no immediate page.

sarah: to be precise tonight: any P1 goes straight to ops-pager and PD escalation flow (ops-pager will notify infra-leads). P2: primary handles, escalate at 10 minutes to secondary (lee) then to maya (eng-manager) at 30 minutes if still degrading.

ops-pager: NOTE: Pager policy reminder: do not page infra-leads for request-level error spikes unless error budget > 5% or impact window > 10m. Use channel updates for transient blips.

lee: if i'm secondary and i get paged, what's expected before i escalate to maya? update incident with steps tried, estimated time-to-fix, and customer list impacted.

alex: that's the right flow. add to that: include a quick triage table in the incident body:
```
- observed (metric + sample): e.g., embed-errors 12% spike at 23:12
- top suspected causes: e.g., model OOM, redis backlog
- mitigation attempted: e.g., fallback -> success/failure
- next steps & owner
```

carla: also remember to run the health-check script under /ops/bin/health_check.sh and paste the output to the incident if you page eng-leads. helps them triage faster.

sarah: runbook pointer for paging rules (paste): https://internal.docs/paging-rules — TL;DR: page after automatic retries fail and error rate persists for 5m for severity escalation; include reproducible logs and sample request ids.

oncall-bot: DEPLOY-BOT: deploy start us-west/canary at 23:30 UTC by deploy-ci; will post status updates.

lee: small note — coverage gap between 02:00-03:00 UTC: maya is out for a meeting then (no pager). sarah, can you cover that 02-03 window as primary?

sarah: i can cover 02:00-02:30 but i need to handover to lee at 02:30 — can you extend to 03:00? otherwise we should escalate to oncall-manager for temporary swap.

lee: i can extend to 03:00. update: i'll be reachable via phone if paged. add phone numbers to PD incident if it's P1.

maya: i'm back now through 01:45 UTC; if things escalate beyond 03:00 please page me even if i'm in meeting (i'll triage high-severity).

carla: customer-impact assessment guidance:
- if >10% of production customers see errors -> mark "major impact" in incident and get comms owner assigned immediately.
- 1–10% -> "partial impact"; use status page minor update after 30m.
- <1% -> track but no external comms unless escalation.

lee: good to have concrete thresholds. how do we attach customer lists quickly? we have lookup via ops-cust-lkp tool, right?

alex: yes run `ops-cust-lkp --query error_code=EMBED_FAIL --since 00:00Z` — dumps customer ids and top requests. paste into incident.

sarah: okay team — summary of tonight's responsibilities I'll leave in the runbook and PD note: primary (sarah) 23:00-02:30, secondary (lee) 23:00-03:00, maya fallback for P1s, carla ops support for escalation contact. please ack this thread when you see it. :white_check_mark:

lee: ack. :thumbsup:

alex: acked. added runbook snippets to PD12345.

carla: ack and will monitor ops alerts.

oncall-bot: REMINDER: please update oncall-status when you leave shift: `/oncall handoff done`

sarah: thanks — leaving final note: if you page eng-leads, include the short triage table and run `health_check.sh` output. that saves them ~10mins. i'll DM the PD creds to lee for the extension window. good luck tonight.

lee: thanks, will do. closing thread. :lock:
